title: PFAS Contamination in Water Supply
request_text: Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I request all documents, emails, and communications related to PFAS, PFOA, PFOS, or 'forever chemicals' contamination in the city's water supply or groundwater from January 1, 2020 to present.
notes: Validation request. Tests generalization beyond 'lead' ambiguity. Acronyms present different challenges than common words.
